title: BPW-2026-0477
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0477
CD 15
REVISED BUDGET – 2H CONSTRUCTION, INC.
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE $700,000 in additional contingency and APPROVE a revised construction budget of $20,857,560 for the Warner Grand Theatre Project; and
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue change orders up to the approved revised construction contingency amount of $2,860,560, for a total contract amount of $20,857,560.
(W.O.: E1908215, C-146776)
summary: Approval of revised construction budget and authorization for change orders for the Warner Grand Theatre Project.

locations.text: Warner Grand Theatre, Los Angeles, CA

outcome.text: REPORT ADOPTED, SUBJECT TO CONDITIONS, FORTHWITH
